contents.text: What is the reason for the change from PN-4471-B to PN-4471-C on CP-200 pumps?

The reason for the change from PN-4471-B to PN-4471-C on CP-200 pumps is wear of the carbon face at seal-water temperatures above 60 °C. PN-4471-C has a silicon-carbide face rated for higher seal-water temperatures.

Engineering change notice ECN-2291: CP-200 mechanical seal › Engineering change notice ECN-2291
|---|---|
| Change notice | ECN-2291 |
| Product | CP-200 centrifugal pump, all sizes |
Effective September 14, 2026, mechanical seal PN-4471-B is superseded by PN-4471-C on all CP-200 pumps.
PN-4471-C has a silicon-carbide face rated for higher seal-water temperatures.
Fit PN-4471-C at the next seal replacement and quarantine remaining PN-4471-B stock.
Reason for the change: three PN-4471-B failures in 2026 were traced to wear of the carbon face at seal-water temperatures above 60 °C.
Affected documents: CP-200 manual (2009) sections 7.2 and 8.1, and SOP-FS-014.
Affected parts
| PN-4471-B | PN-4471-C | Quarantine remaining stock; return to Fabrikam Seals for credit |

SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
# SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
This revision replaces PN-4471-B with PN-4471-C, following ECN-2291.
4. Fit mechanical seal PN-4471-C.
Don't mix PN-4471-B and PN-4471-C parts.

Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal (training) › Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal › Fitting PN-4471-C
## Fitting PN-4471-C
- Don't mix PN-4471-B and PN-4471-C parts
The old torque of 22 N·m applied to PN-4471-B.
Fabrikam Seals confirmed 25 N·m for PN-4471-C.

Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal (training) › Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal › Why seals fail
In 2026, three PN-4471-B failures at Riverside were traced to carbon face wear at seal-water temperatures above 60 °C.
That is why ECN-2291 introduced PN-4471-C with a silicon-carbide face.
